name: Birgi, God of Storytelling // Harnfel, Horn of Bounty
clause: Creatures you control can boast twice during each of your turns rather than once.

needs.proposedSignature: activated-ability flag `boast?: true` (activate only if this creature attacked this turn, and only once each turn), plus StaticEffect { kind: 'boast-limit', scope: 'you-control' | 'all', filter?: Filter, times: number }
needs.semantics: Boast (CR 702.141a) is an activation restriction the engine has no shape for: `oncePerTurn` exists but 'only if this creature attacked this turn' does not, and there is no per-turn activation COUNT that another permanent can raise. Birgi's line raises that count from one to two for every creature its controller controls, so the limit has to be a named quantity a static can modify rather than a boolean on the ability.
needs.clause: Creatures you control can boast twice during each of your turns rather than once.
